content: Forgiveness is the supreme strength of the mighty, and the highest ornament of the peaceful.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Kshama balam ashaktanam shaktanam bhushanam kshama (क्षमा बलं अशक्तानां) — Vidura Niti
explanation: When the weak person fails to retaliate, people mistake it for necessity. But when the person who holds absolute power, leverage, and legal authority chooses to forgive an offender, that mercy shines as the supreme summit of human majesty.
practicalInsight: If you hold leverage or the upper hand over someone who has wronged you, choose mercy over vindictive triumph.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you using your position or strength to crush an opponent when you could illuminate the world through magnanimous forgiveness?
